skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, contents, tasks, and positions of various sub-plans within the economic development planning system.
Master the process of formulating growth rate plans using investment models and linear regression models.
Learn the process of formulating structural change plans for economic sectors using input-output models and linear regression models.
Understand the methods and calculations involved in social sector planning.
Learn the approach and process of formulating investment capital plans and understand how to calculate relevant indices.
Understand the methods and calculations involved in labor and employment planning.
Learn the approach and process of formulating budget plans and understand how to calculate relevant indices.
Understand the principles and methods of formulating policies for effective exploitation, mobilization, and utilization of resources.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate the implementation of plans and policies.
Enhance teamwork skills through group activities and discussions.
Improve technical writing skills by preparing reports and presentations on analysis and evaluation of plans and policies.
Develop self-learning skills to independently acquire and apply knowledge.
Enhance presentation skills by presenting findings and recommendations on analysis and evaluation of plans and policies.
Develop ethical awareness and social responsibility in the field of economic development planning.
